description: ChannelBreakout v2.2 MTG+BCD plus BBm375/1.5 breakout confirmation and Donchian retest confirmation: after a raw breakout, wait up to 96 completed 5m bars for a 0.5% retest of the Donchian breakout level, require close to hold the breakout and still satisfy the Bollinger breakout direction, then emit the entry signal one completed bar later.

research_metrics.notes: Research replay used a next-open execution model. The generic StrategyEvaluator is close-price based; this strategy emits the retest entry signal one completed bar after confirmation so live execution can happen after the confirmation candle closes. Exact next-open backtest accounting needs an open-price-aware evaluator.

bull.description: 375/432 long-only; daily close below EMA50 for 3 completed days disables/closes long; mature trend guard overlay; requires BBm375/1.5 breakout confirmation plus Donchian retest w96/tol50bp/BB still valid.

bear.description: 375/432 dual with mature trend guard and BEAR cooldown after two consecutive losing BEAR-entry trades; requires BBm375/1.5 breakout confirmation plus Donchian retest w96/tol50bp/BB still valid.

neutral.description: 375/432 directional; long/short only when close and EMA50 slope agree; mature trend guard overlay; requires BBm375/1.5 breakout confirmation plus Donchian retest w96/tol50bp/BB still valid.

expected_behavior_change: Do not enter immediately on a v2.2+BB raw Donchian breakout. Create a pending breakout, wait up to 96 completed 5m bars for a 0.5% retest of the shifted Donchian breakout level, require the confirmation close to hold the breakout and remain outside the matching shifted BBm375/1.5 band, then emit the entry signal one bar later. Keep v2.2 regime permission, mature trend exit, and BEAR cooldown unchanged.
